title: A Nepali Architect Built Beijing's White Stupa in 1279 | China Travel Expert
description:
A Nepali architect built Beijing's White Stupa in 1279 - which white stupa would you visit?

The White Stupa at Miaoying Temple (Baita Si) was designed by Araniko, a young Nepali artist and architect who came to the Yuan court and built it for Kublai Khan. Dated to 1279 and standing about 51 m, it is the oldest and largest Tibetan-style stupa in China. Beijing has a second, later white stupa too - the White Dagoba in Beihai Park, built in 1651 and about 36 m tall.

🧭 Expert Tip: The Miaoying (Baita Si) stupa sits on a quiet hutong street and is easy to walk past - pair it with Beihai Park to see both of Beijing's great white stupas in one day.
